$comment: The one list of collage's template functions: the grammar, completion and hover are all built from it. Keep it in step with collage's DefaultFuncs and the plugins' AddTemplateFunc/AddRenderFunc calls.

functions.name: slot
functions.doc: Renders the fragments bound to this fragment's slot named `name`, in binding order. A slot nothing fills renders empty.

functions.name: hoist
functions.doc: Marks where content hoisted into `area` lands — the stylesheets, titles and meta tags fragments declare. The layout puts `{{hoist "head"}}` in its `<head>`.

functions.name: asset
functions.doc: A mounted file's content-addressed URL, cacheable forever: `/static/app.3f9a….css`. An unknown path fails the render.

functions.name: stylesheet
functions.doc: Hoists a `<link rel="stylesheet">` for a mounted file into the head, by its content-addressed URL. Renders nothing where it is called.

functions.name: csrfToken
functions.doc: The hidden input a form's forgery token travels in. Every form that posts to an action needs it.

functions.name: pageURL
functions.doc: The URL of the page or document registered as `name`, in this render's locale, with parameters filling its pattern. A link that cannot be built fails the render.

functions.name: pageURLIn
functions.doc: `pageURL` in exactly the locale given.

functions.name: localeURL
functions.doc: The page being rendered, in another locale, with the same path parameters — what a language switcher is made of. Empty when the page has no path in that locale.

functions.name: actionURL
functions.doc: The URL of the action registered under that name, in this render's locale — what a form's `action` attribute holds. A page's own action is `"page:POST"` unless it was named. Since collage v0.36.0.

functions.name: fragmentURL
functions.doc: The path a page opened for one of its fragments with `WithFragmentPath`, in this render's locale.

functions.name: fragmentURLIn
functions.doc: `fragmentURL` in exactly the locale given.

functions.name: safeHTML
functions.doc: Marks a string as trusted HTML, so it is not escaped. An escape hatch: only for markup you produced or validated.

functions.name: safeURL
functions.doc: Marks a string as a trusted URL, so html/template does not replace an unusual scheme with `#ZgotmplZ`. Validate it first.

functions.name: dict
functions.doc: Builds a map from key and value pairs, to pass several values to a sub-template.

functions.name: default
functions.doc: `value`, or `fallback` when `value` is empty.

functions.name: upper
functions.doc: The string in upper case.

functions.name: lower
functions.doc: The string in lower case.

functions.name: title
functions.doc: The string with each word's first letter in upper case.

functions.name: join
functions.doc: The items joined with `sep`, as `strings.Join`.

functions.name: formatTime
functions.doc: The time formatted with a Go layout: `"2006-01-02"`, `"2 Jan 2006"`.

functions.name: liveClient
functions.doc: The collage-live client script. Put it in the layout's `<head>`; elements marked `data-collage-fragment` are then kept current.

functions.name: searchBox
functions.doc: An accessible search form and its script, searching the index an export writes.

functions.name: offlineScript
functions.doc: Registers the service worker that keeps visited pages available offline. Renders nothing in development. With a CSP: `{{offlineScript cspNonce}}`.

functions.name: cspNonce
functions.doc: The response's Content-Security-Policy nonce, for an inline script or style: `<script nonce="{{cspNonce}}">`. Fresh on every response, even for a cached page.

functions.name: flashes
functions.doc: The flash messages this request arrived with, each with `.Kind` and `.Text`; reading them clears them. `{{range flashes}}…{{end}}`.

functions.name: t
functions.doc: The translation of `key` in the render's locale; name and value pairs fill `{name}`. Falls back to the default locale, then to the key.

functions.name: th
functions.doc: `t` for a translation holding markup: the catalog's markup is trusted, the values filling it are escaped.

functions.name: tn
functions.doc: The plural form of `key` for `count` — `zero`, `one` or `other` — with `{count}` filled.

functions.name: fieldError
functions.doc: The message for a field a refused submission failed, or empty.

functions.name: fieldValue
functions.doc: What was submitted for a field, to fill the input again after a refusal; `fallback` on the first render. Passwords are never echoed.

functions.name: hasErrors
functions.doc: Whether the submission being shown again was refused.

functions.name: honeypot
functions.doc: The invisible decoy field and signed timestamp that stop form spam bots, and protect the path the form posts to. `seconds` is the least time the form must be open before it is sent, signed into the timestamp; none by default.

functions.name: highlight
functions.doc: The code syntax-highlighted with CSS classes, and the stylesheet hoisted into the head.

functions.name: toc
functions.doc: A table of contents of the page's h2–h4 headings, as a nested `<nav><ol>`.

functions.name: readingTime
functions.doc: "N min read" for the page's text.

functions.name: bundle
functions.doc: The content-hashed URL of a bundle esbuild built: `<script src="{{bundle "app.js"}}" defer>`.

attributes.name: data-collage-fragment
attributes.doc: collage-live: the fragment path whose answer fills the element.

attributes.name: data-collage-interval
attributes.doc: collage-live: fetch the fragment on this interval (`500ms`, `2s`, `1m`).

attributes.name: data-collage-push
attributes.doc: collage-live: take the fragment from the stream when the server pushes it.

attributes.name: data-collage-swap
attributes.doc: collage-live: `morph` patches the DOM in place, so a focused input keeps what is typed.

attributes.name: data-collage-target
attributes.doc: collage-live: on a form, submit with fetch and put the answer into this element.
